newsitem.title: USA: GulfMark files with SEC to register shares.
newsitem.headline: GulfMark files with SEC to register shares.

text.p: Gulfmark Offshore Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to one million common shares.
The Houston-based company said proceeds from the sale will be used to fund capital expenditures, repay debt and other corporate needs.
Underwriters for the offering, Lehman Brothers, Jeffries & Co Inc and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 250,000 shares.
After the offering, the company will have 7,765,893 shares outstanding.
